LU01.location: On the anterior thoracic region, at the same level as the 1st intercostal space, lateral to the infraclavicular fossa, 6 cun lateral to the anterior midline
location_notes: at the same level as the 2nd intercostal space
LU01.guide: After locating LU2, LU1 is located 1 cun inferior to LU2.
muscle: short head of the biceps brachii
nerve: lateral cutaneous branch of the intercostal nerve
LU01.caution: Puncture towards the superolateral side of the thoracic cage in case of the damage of the lung.
LU01.usage: disease of the thorax and lung

LU02.location: On the anterior thoracic region, in the depression of the infraclavicular fossa, medial to the coracoid process of the scapula, 6 cun lateral to the anterior midline
location_notes: at the same level as the 1st intercostal space
LU02.guide: LU2 is in the center of the deltopectoral triangle, which is identified with the arm slightly flexed and abducted against resistance.
LU02.caution: Do not puncture deeply towards the medial side of the thoracic cage.
LU02.usage: disease of the thorax and lung

LU03.location: On the anterolateral aspect of the arm, just lateral to the lateral border of the biceps brachii, 3 cun inferior to the anterior axillary fold
LU03.guide: On the line connecting the anterior axillary fold and LU5, LU3 is located at the junction of the proximal 1/3 and the distal 2/3.
muscle: long head of the biceps brachii
LU03.caution: No direct moxibustion to avoid the damage of the superficial blood vessels
LU03.usage: disease of the nose and lung

LU04.location: On the anterolateral aspect of the arm, just lateral to the lateral border of the biceps brachii, 4 cun inferior to the anterior axillary fold
LU04.guide: On the line connecting the anterior axillary fold and LU5, LU4 is located 1 cun distal to the junction of the proximal 1/3 and the distal 2/3.
muscle: long head of the biceps brachii
LU04.usage: disease of the thorax and lung

LU05.location: On the anterior aspect of the elbow, at the cubital crease, in the depression lateral to the tendon of the biceps brachii
LU05.guide: With the elbow flexed, LU5 is located between LI11 and PC3 at the cubital crease.
LU05.usage: disease of the lung and throat

LU06.location: On the anterolateral aspect of the forearm, on the line connecting LU5 and LU9, 7 cun superior to the palmar wrist crease
LU06.guide: LU6 is 5 cun inferior to LU5, and 1 cun proximal to the midpoint of the line connecting LU5 and LU9.
nerve: superficial branch of the radial nerve
LU06.usage: disease of the lung and throat

LU07.location: On the radial aspect of the forearm, between the tendons of the abductor pollicis longus and the extensor pollicis brevis, in the depression of the groove for the abductor pollicis longus tendon, 1.5 cun superior to the palmar wrist crease
muscle: tendon of the abductor pollicis longus
tendon of the extensor pollicis brevis
tendon of the extensor carpi radialis longus
nerve: superficial branch of the radial nerve
LU07.caution: Pronator quadratus is the anatomical target when punctured perpendicularly.
LU07.specificity: Luo-connecting point, Eight confluent point(CV), Command point
LU07.usage: disease of the lung, throat, head and posterior neck

LU08.location: On the anterolateral aspect of the forearm, between the radial styloid process and the radial artery, 1 cun superior to the palmar wrist crease
muscle: tendon of the flexor pollicis longus
nerve: superficial branch of the radial nerve
LU08.caution: No manipulation to avoid the damage to the radial artery
LU08.usage: disease of the heart, lung and throat

LU09.location: On the anterolateral aspect of the wrist, between the radial styloid process and the scaphoid bone, in the depression ulnar to the abductor pollicis longus tendon
muscle: tendon of the flexor carpi radialis
tendon of the flexor pollicis longus
nerve: superficial branch of the radial nerve
LU09.caution: Puncture towards the dorsal from the palmar side to avoid the damage of the radial artery
LU09.usage: disease of the lung and throat

LU10.location: On the palm, radial to the midpoint of the 1st metacarpal bone, at the border between the red and white flesh
muscle: tendon of the flexor pollicis longus
nerve: common palmar digital branch of the median nerve
vessel: superficial palmar branch of the radial artery
LU10.usage: disease of the lung and throat

LU11.location: On the thumb, radial to the distal phalanx, 0.1 cun proximal-lateral to the radial corner of the thumb nail
LU11.guide: LU11 is at the intersection of the vertical line of the radial border and the horizontal line of the base of the thumb nail.
nerve: proper palmar digital nerve (from the median nerve)
dorsal digital nerve (from the radial nerve)
LU11.usage: disease of the lung and throat

LI01.location: On the index finger, radial to the distal phalanx, 0.1 cun proximal-lateral to the radial corner of the index fingernail
LI01.guide: LI1 is at the intersection of the vertical line of the radial border of the fingernail and the horizontal line of the base of the index finger.
nerve: dorsal branch of the proper palmar digital nerve
LI01.usage: disease of the mouth, teeth and throat

LI02.location: On the index finger, in the depression distal to the radial side of the 2nd metacarpophalangeal joint, at the border between the red and white flesh
nerve: proper palmar digital nerve (from the median nerve)
dorsal digital nerve (from the radial nerve)
LI02.usage: disease of the mouth, teeth, throat and nose

LI03.location: On the dorsum of the hand, in the depression radial and proximal to the 2nd metacarpophalangeal joint
nerve: proper palmar digital nerve (from the median nerve)
dorsal digital nerve (from the radial nerve)
LI03.usage: disease of the mouth, teeth, throat and eyes

LI04.location: On the dorsum of the hand, radial to the midpoint of the 2nd metacarpal bone
muscle: oblique head of the adductor pollicis muscle
nerve: dorsal digital nerve (from the radial nerve)
deep branch of the ulnar nerve
LI04.caution: Pregnant women especially with the experience of miscarriage should be treated carefully
LI04.usage: disease of the mouth, throat and face

LI05.location: On the postero-lateral aspect of the wrist, at the radial side of the dorsal wrist crease, distal to the radial styloid process, in the depression of the anatomical snuffbox
LI05.guide: • The depression of the anatomical snuffbox is made between the tendons of the extensor pollicis longus and the extensor pollicis brevis, when the thumb is fully abducted and extended. • LI5 is located at the same level as SI5 and TE4.
nerve: superficial branch of the radial nerve
vessel: dorsal carpal branch of the radial artery
LI05.usage: disease of the mouth, teeth, throat and eyes

LI06.location: On the postero-lateral aspect of the forearm, on the line connecting LI5 and LI11, 3 cun superior to the dorsal wrist crease
LI06.guide: LI6 is located at the junction of the upper 3/4 and the lower 1/4 of the line connecting LI5 and LI11.
nerve: superficial branch of the radial nerve
LI06.usage: disease of the mouth, teeth, throat and ears

LI07.location: On the postero-lateral aspect of the forearm, on the line connecting LI5 and LI11, 5 cun superior to the dorsal wrist crease
nerve: superficial branch of the radial nerve
LI07.usage: disease of the head, face and throat

LI08.location: On the postero-lateral aspect of the forearm, on the line connecting LI5 and LI11, 4 cun inferior to the cubital crease
nerve: deep branch of the radial nerve

LI09.location: On the postero-lateral aspect of the forearm, on the line connecting LI5 and LI11, 3 cun inferior to the cubital crease
nerve: deep branch of the radial nerve

LI10.location: On the postero-lateral aspect of the forearm, on the line connecting LI5 and LI11, 2 cun inferior to the cubital crease
nerve: deep branch of the radial nerve

LI11.location: On the lateral aspect of the elbow, at the midpoint of the line connecting LU5 and the lateral epicondyle of the humerus
LI11.guide: When the elbow is fully flexed and the palm is placed on the opposite chest, LI11 is located in the depression at the lateral end of the cubital crease.
LI11.specificity: He-Sea point, Seven points of CVA
LI11.usage: disease of the mouth, teeth, throat and skin

LI12.location: On the postero-lateral aspect of the elbow, superior to the lateral epicondyle of the humerus, anterior to the lateral supraepicondylar ridge

LI13.location: On the lateral aspect of the arm, on the line connecting LI11 and LI15, 3 cun superior to the cubital crease

LI14.location: On the lateral aspect of the arm, just anterior to the border of the deltoid muscle, 7 cun superior to LI11
LI14.guide: LI14 can be found with the arm abducted.
muscle: long head of the biceps brachii

LI15.location: On the shoulder girdle, in the depression between the anterior end of the lateral border of the acromion and the greater tubercle of the humerus
LI15.guide: With the arm abducted, two depressions appear. ┌ LI15 is located in the anterior to the acromion. └ TE14 is located in the posterior to the acromion.
muscle: tendon of the long head of the biceps brachii
vessel: posterior circumflex humeral artery and vein

LI16.location: On the shoulder girdle, in the depression between the acromial end of the clavicle and the spine of the scapula
LI16.caution: A strong stimulation may cause fainting.

LI17.location: On the anterior aspect of the neck, at the same level as the cricoid cartilage, just posterior to the border of the sternocleidomastoid muscle
LI17.guide: LI17 is directly inferior to LI18 and at the same level as ST10.

LI18.location: On the anterior aspect of the neck, at the same level as the superior border of the thyroid cartilage, between the anterior and posterior borders of the sternocleidomastoid muscle
LI18.guide: LI18 is at the same level as ST9.

LI19.location: On the face, at the same level as the midpoint of the philtrum, inferior to the lateral margin of the nostril
LI19.guide: LI19 is 0.5 cun lateral to GV26.
nerve: buccal branch of the facial nerve
LI19.usage: disease of the nose and mouth

LI20.location: On the face, in the nasolabial sulcus, at the same level as the midpoint of the lateral border of the ala of the nose
nerve: buccal branch of the facial nerve
LI20.usage: disease of the nose and mouth

ST01.location: On the face, between the eyeball and the infraorbital margin, directly inferior to the pupil

ST02.location: On the face, in the infraorbital foramen
ST02.guide: Infraorbital foramen can be palpated directly inferior to the pupil.
nerve: zygomatic branch of the facial nerve
ST02.usage: disease of the eye and face

ST03.location: On the face, directly inferior to the pupil, at the same level as the inferior border of the ala of the nose
ST03.guide: When looking straight ahead, ST3 is located at the intersection of the vertical line of the pupil and the horizontal line of the inferior border of the ala of the nose.
nerve: zygomatic branch of the facial nerve
buccal branch of the facial nerve
ST03.usage: disease of the eye and face

ST04.location: On the face, 0.4 cun lateral to the oral angle
ST04.guide: Lateral to the angle of the mouth, ST4 is located in the nasolabial sulcus or on the continuation of the nasolabial sulcus.
nerve: buccal branch of the facial nerve
ST04.usage: disease of the eye and face

ST05.location: On the face, anterior to the angle of the mandible, in the depression anterior to the masseter attachment, over the facial artery
ST05.guide: When the month is closed and filled with air, ST5 is located in the depression, antero-inferior to the angle of the mandible.
nerve: mandibular branch of the face nerve
ST05.usage: disease of the mouth and face

ST06.location: On the face, 1 cun antero-superior to the angle of the mandible
ST06.guide: • On the bisector of the angle of the mandible. • ST6 becomes prominent with the mouth closed and the teeth clenched and becomes depressed when the cleched teeth are released.
nerve: buccal branch of the facial nerve
mandibular branch of the facial nerve
ST06.usage: disease of the teeth and face

ST07.location: On the face, in the depression between the midpoint of the inferior border of the zygomatic arch and the mandibular notch
ST07.guide: With the mouth closed, ST7 is located at the depression inferior to the zygomatic arch, directly inferior to GB3.
nerve: zygomatic branch of the facial nerve
ST07.usage: disease of the teeth, face and ear

ST08.location: On the head, 0.5 cun directly superior to the anterior hairline at the corner of the forehead, 4.5 cun lateral to the anterior midline
vessel: frontal branch of the superficial temporal artery and vein
ST08.usage: disease of the eye, head and face

ST09.location: In the anterior region of the neck, at the same level as the superior border of the thyroid cartilage, anterior to the sternocleidomastoid, over the common carotid artery
nerve: cervical branch of the facial nerve
ST09.usage: disease of the lung, throat, thyroid gland and common carotid artery

ST10.location: In the anterior region of the neck, at the same level as the cricoid cartilage, just anterior to the border of the sternocleidomastoid
nerve: cervical branch of the facial nerve
ST10.usage: disease of the lung and throat

ST11.location: In the anterior region of the neck, in the lesser supraclavicular fossa, superior to the sternal end of the clavicle, in the depression between the sternal and clavicular heads of the sternocleidomastoid
ST11.caution: Fainting due to the strong stimulation
ST11.usage: disease of the lung and throat

ST12.location: In the anterior region of the neck, in the greater supraclavicular fossa, 4 cun lateral to the anterior midline, in the depression superior to the clavicle
ST12.caution: Oblique needle insertion is recommended to prevent damage of the external carotid artery, infraclavicular artery and vein. Also, the superior border of the lung is located deep inside ST12.
ST12.usage: disease of the thorax and lung

ST13.location: In the anterior thoracic region, inferior to the clavicle, 4 cun lateral to the anterior midline(CV21), at the same level as KI27 and LU2
vessel: clavicular branch of the thoracoacromial artery
ST13.caution: No deep insertion to prevent damage of the lung (1st intercostal space to 6th intercostal space)
ST13.usage: disease of the thorax and lung

ST14.location: In the anterior thoracic region, in the 1st intercostal space, 4 cun lateral to the anterior midline(CV20), at the same level as KI26 and LU1
vessel: clavicular branch of the thoracoacromial artery and vein
anterior intercostal branch of the internal thoracic artery and vein
ST14.caution: No deep insertion to prevent damage of the lung (1st intercostal space to 6th intercostal space)
ST14.usage: disease of the thorax and lung

ST15.location: In the anterior thoracic region, in the 2nd intercostal space, 4 cun lateral to the anterior midline
ST15.guide: The 2nd intercostal space is inferior to the 2nd rib, which is at the same level as the sternal angle. In the case of men, ST15 can be palpated two ribs superior to the center of the nipple. ST15 is located slightly superior to the CV19 and KI2 because the ribs are bow-shaped.
vessel: anterior intercostal branch of the internal thoracic artery and vein
ST15.caution: No deep insertion to prevent damage of the lung (1st intercostal space to 6th intercostal space)
ST15.usage: disease of the lung and breast

ST16.location: In the anterior thoracic region, in the 3rd intercostal space, 4 cun lateral to the anterior midline(CV18)
vessel: anterior intercostal branch of the internal thoracic artery and vein
ST16.caution: No deep insertion to prevent damage of the lung (1st intercostal space to 6th intercostal space)
ST16.usage: disease of the lung and breast

ST17.location: In the anterior thoracic region, at the center of the nipple
ST17.guide: In the case of men, the center of the nipple is located in the 4th intercostal space.
vessel: anterior intercostal branch of the internal thoracic artery and vein
ST17.usage: disease of the breast, gynecological disease, mental disease

ST18.location: In the anterior thoracic region, in the 5th intercostal space, 4 cun lateral to the anterior midline
ST18.guide: • In the case of men, ST18 is located at the intersection of the vertical line of the nipple and the 5th intercostal space. • In the case of women, ST18 is located at the midpoint of the inferior crease of the breast.
vessel: anterior intercostal branch of the internal thoracic artery and vein
ST18.usage: disease of the breast, thorax and lung

ST19.location: On the upper abdomen, 6 cun superior to the center of the umbilicus, 2 cun lateral to the anterior midline
ST19.guide: • ST19 is 2 cun lateral to CV14, inferior to the costal angle. • If the infrasternal angle is so narrow that ST19 is located on the costal angle, ST19 can be reached by oblique insertion under the ribs.
nerve: anterior cutaneous branch of 6th-8th intercostal nerve
ST19.caution: No deep insertion to avoid damage of the liver or stomach

ST20.location: On the upper abdomen, 5 cun superior to the center of the umbilicus, 2 cun lateral to the anterior midline
nerve: anterior cutaneous branch of 6th-8th intercostal nerve
ST20.caution: No deep insertion to avoid damage of the liver, stomach or the duodenum

ST21.location: On the upper abdomen, 4 cun superior to the center of the umbilicus, 2 cun lateral to the anterior midline
nerve: anterior cutaneous branch of 7th-9th intercostal nerve
ST21.caution: • No deep insertion to avoid damage of the liver or stomach • No moxibustion for pregnant women

ST22.location: On the upper abdomen, 3 cun superior to the center of the umbilicus, 2 cun lateral to the anterior midline
nerve: anterior cutaneous branch of 7th-9th intercostal nerve

ST23.location: On the upper abdomen, 2 cun superior to the center of the umbilicus, 2 cun lateral to the anterior midline
nerve: anterior cutaneous branch of 8th-10th intercostal nerve
ST23.usage: disease of the digestive system, mental disease

ST24.location: On the upper abdomen, 1 cun superior to the center of the umbilicus, 2 cun lateral to the anterior midline
nerve: anterior cutaneous branch of 8th-10th intercostal nerve
ST24.usage: disease of the digestive system, mental disease

ST25.location: On the upper abdomen, 2 cun lateral to the center of the umbilicus
ST25.guide: ST25 is at the same level as CV8, KI16 and SP15.
nerve: anterior cutaneous branch of 9th-11th intercostal nerve
ST25.caution: Acupuncture to pregnant women should be considered carefully
ST25.specificity: Front-Mu point of the large intestine
ST25.usage: disease of the digestive system, gynecological disease

ST26.location: On the lower abdomen, 1 cun inferior to the center of the umbilicus, 2 cun lateral to the anterior midline
nerve: anterior cutaneous branch of 10th-11th intercostal nerve
anterior cutaneous branch of the subcostal nerve

ST27.location: On the lower abdomen, 2 cun inferior to the center of the umbilicus, 2 cun lateral to the anterior midline
nerve: anterior cutaneous branch of 10th-11th intercostal nerve
anterior cutaneous branch of the subcostal nerve
ST27.usage: disease of the abdomen and urogenital system

ST28.location: On the lower abdomen, 3 cun inferior to the center of the umbilicus, 2 cun lateral to the anterior midline
nerve: anterior cutaneous branch of 11th intercostal nerve
anterior cutaneous branch of the subcostal nerve
ST28.usage: disease of the urogenital system, gynecological disease

ST29.location: On the lower abdomen, 4 cun inferior to the center of the umbilicus, 2 cun lateral to the anterior midline
nerve: anterior cutaneous branch of the subcostal nerve
anterior cutaneous branch of the iliohypogastric nerve
ST29.usage: disease of the urogenital system, gynecological disease

ST30.location: In the groin region, at the same level as the superior border of the pubic symphysis, 2 cun lateral to the anterior midline, over the femoral artery
nerve: anterior cutaneous branch of the subcostal nerve
anterior cutaneous branch of the iliohypogastric nerve
ST30.caution: Try not to damage the femoral artery.
ST30.usage: disease of the urogenital system, gynecological disease

ST31.location: On the anterior aspect of the thigh, in the depression between three muscles: the proximal portion of the rectus femoris, the sartorius and the tensor fasciae latae
ST31.guide: With the hip and the knee slightly flexed and the thigh slightly abducted against resistance, a triangular depression appears. The proximal portion of the rectus femoris is found between the sartorius and the tensor fascia latae. ST31 is located in the depression inferior to the apex of this triangle. ST31 is located at the intersection of the line connecting the lateral end of the base of the patella and the anterior superior iliac spine, and the horizontal line of the inferior border of the pubic symphysis.
nerve: muscular branch of the femoral nerve
vessel: superficial circumflex iliac artery and vein
lateral circumflex femoral artery and vein

ST32.location: On the antero-lateral aspect of the thigh, on the line connecting the lateral end of the base of the patella and the anterior superior iliac spine, 6 cun superior to the base of the patella
nerve: anterior cutaneous branch of the femoral nerve
vessel: descending branch of the lateral circumflex femoral artery

ST33.location: On the antero-lateral aspect of the thigh, lateral to the rectus femoris tendon, 3 cun superior to the base of the patella
ST33.guide: ST33 is at the midpoint of the line connecting ST32 and the lateral end of the base of the patella.
nerve: anterior cutaneous branch of the femoral nerve
vessel: descending branch of the lateral circumflex femoral artery

ST34.location: On the antero-lateral aspect of the thigh, between the vastus lateralis and the lateral border of the rectus femoris tendon, 2 cun superior to the base of the patella
ST34.guide: ST34 is located 1 cun directly inferior to ST33.
nerve: anterior cutaneous branch of the femoral nerve
vessel: descending branch of the lateral circumflex femoral artery
ST34.usage: disease of the lower limb and breast

ST35.location: On the anterior aspect of the knee, in the depression lateral to the patellar ligament
ST35.guide: With the knee flexed, ST35 is in the depression inferior lateral to the patella.
nerve: anterior cutaneous branch of the femoral nerve
recurrent articular branch of the common fibular nerve
infrapatellar branch of the saphenous nerve
articular branch of the tibial nerve
ST35.caution: Infection of the articular cavity of the knee joint

ST36.location: On the anterior aspect of the leg, on the line connecting ST35 and ST41, 3 cun distal to ST35
ST36.guide: • With the ankles relaxed in a sitting position or knees flexed in a supine position, ST36 is located 3 cun distal to ST35. • ST36 forms an equilateral triangle with the tuberosity of tibia and the head of fibula. ST36 is located on the tibialis anterior.
nerve: medial crural cutaneous branch of the saphenous nerve
ST36.specificity: He-sea point, Lower He-sea point of the stomach, Command point, Seven Points of CVA
ST36.usage: disease of the digestive system, severe fatigue

ST37.location: On the anterior aspect of the leg, on the line connecting ST35 and ST41, 6 cun distal to ST35
ST37.guide: With the ankles relaxed in a sitting position or knees flexed in a supine position, ST37 is on the tibialis anterior.
nerve: medial crural cutaneous branch of the saphenous nerve
ST37.specificity: Lower He-sea point of the large intestine

ST38.location: On the anterior aspect of the leg, on the line connecting ST35 and ST41, 8 cun distal to ST35
ST38.guide: ST38 is located on the tibialis anterior muscle, at the same level as ST40.
nerve: medial crural cutaneous branch of the saphenous nerve

ST39.location: On the anterior aspect of the leg, on the line connecting ST35 and ST41, 9 cun distal to ST35
ST39.guide: ST39 is located on the tibialis anterior muscle, at the same level as GB35 and GB36.
nerve: medial crural cutaneous branch of the saphenous nerve
ST39.specificity: Lower He-sea point of the small intestine
ST39.usage: disease of the small intestine and breast

ST40.location: On the anterolateral aspect of the leg, lateral border of the tibialis anterior, 8 cun proximal to the prominence of the lateral malleolus
ST40.guide: ST40 is 1 cun lateral to ST38.
ST40.usage: disease of the digestive system, phlegm syndrome

ST41.location: On the anterior aspect of the ankle, at the center of the front surface of the ankle joint, in the depression between the tendons of extensor hallucis longus and extensor digitorum longus
ST41.guide: ST41 is located between two tendons on the dorsum of the foot which become more distinct with the ankle dorsiflexed. It is at the midpoint of the line connecting the prominences of the lateral malleolus and the medial malleolus.
vessel: venous arch of the great saphenous vein
ST41.usage: disease of the head, neck and abdomen

ST42.location: On the dorsum of the foot, at the joint of the base of the 2nd metatarsal bone and the intermediate cuneiform, over the dorsalis pedis artery
muscle: tendon of the extensor digitorum longus
nerve: dorsal digital nerve from the superficial fibular nerve
ST42.caution: Insert toward plantar side from the dorsal side. Avoid damage of the dorsalis pedis artery and vein.

ST43.location: On the dorsum of the foot, between the 2nd and the 3rd metatarsal bones, in the depression proximal to the 2nd metatarsophalangeal joint
muscle: tendon of the extensor digitorum longus
tendon of the extensor digitorum brevis
nerve: dorsal digital nerve from the superficial fibular nerve
ST43.usage: disease of the digestive system, phlegm syndrome

ST44.location: On the dorsum of the foot, between the 2nd and 3rd toes, posterior to the web margin, at the border between the red and white flesh
muscle: tendon of the extensor digitorum longus
tendon of the extensor digitorum brevis
nerve: dorsal digital nerve from the superficial fibular nerve
ST44.usage: disease of the digestive system, head and face

ST45.location: On the 2nd toe, lateral to the distal phalanx, 0.1 cun proximal-lateral to the lateral corner of the 2nd toenail
ST45.usage: disease of the head and face, mental disease

SP01.location: On the great toe, medial to the distal phalanx, 0.1 cun proximal-medial to the medial corner of the toenail
SP01.guide: SP1 is at the intersection of the vertical line of the medial border and the horizontal line of the base of the toenail.
vessel: proper plantar digital artery and vein
SP01.usage: disease of the digestive system, gynecological disease

SP02.location: On the great toe, in the depression distal to the 1st metatarsophalangeal joint, at the border between the red and white flesh
muscle: tendon of the flexor hallucis longus

SP03.location: On the medial aspect of the foot, in the depression proximal to the 1st metatarsophalangeal joint, at the border between the red and white flesh.

SP04.location: On the medial aspect of the foot, antero-inferior to the base of the 1st metatarsal bone, at the border between the red and white flesh
SP04.guide: SP4 is located in the depression which can be palpated when moving proximally from SP3.
SP04.specificity: Luo-connecting point, Eight confluent point (thoroughfare meridian)

SP05.location: On the medial aspect of the foot, antero-inferior to the medial malleolus, in the depression midway between the tuberosity of the navicular bone and the prominence of the medial malleolus
muscle: deltoid ligament of the ankle joint

SP06.location: On the tibial aspect of the leg, posterior to the medial border of the tibia, 3 cun superior to the prominence of the medial malleolus
nerve: medial crural cutaneous branch of the saphenous nerve
SP06.caution: Acupuncture or moxibustion to pregnant women should be considered carefully.
SP06.usage: disease of the digestive and urogenital system, gynecological disease

SP07.location: On the tibial aspect of the leg, posterior to the medial border of the tibia, 6 cun superior to the prominence of the medial malleolus
nerve: medial crural cutaneous branch of the saphenous nerve
SP07.usage: disease of the digestive and urogenital system

SP08.location: On the tibial aspect of the leg, posterior to the medial border of the tibia, 3 cun inferior to SP9
nerve: medial crural cutaneous branch of the saphenous nerve
SP08.usage: disease of the digestive and urogenital system

SP09.location: On the tibial aspect of the leg, in the depression between the inferior border of the medial condyle of the tibia and the medial border of the tibia
SP09.guide: With the knee flexed, a depression can be palpated when moving proximally along the medial border of the tibia. SP9 is located in the depression at the angle formed by the inferior border of the medial condyle of the tibia and the posterior border of the tibia.
vessel: medial inferior genicular artery and vein
SP09.caution: No deep insertion to prevent damage of the posterior tibial artery and vein
SP09.usage: disease of the digestive and urogenital system, gynecological disease

SP10.location: On the antero-medial aspect of the thigh, on the bulge of the vastus medialis muscle, 2 cun superior to the medial end of the base of the patella
SP10.guide: With the knee flexed, place the palm on the tip of the apex of patella and open the thumb and index finger at an angle of 45°. Then, SP10 is located at the tip of the thumb.
nerve: anterior cutaneous branch of the femoral nerve
muscular branch of the femoral nerve
SP10.caution: No deep insertion to prevent damage of the posterior tibial artery and vein
SP10.usage: disease of the skin and blood, gynecological disease

SP11.location: On the medial aspect of the thigh, at the junction of the upper 1/3 and lower 2/3 of the line connecting the medial end of the base of the patella and SP12, between the sartorius and the adductor longus, over the femoral artery
